# SSOJet

> > SSOJet enables developers to add enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM) to B2B SaaS applications without rebuilding authentication infrastructure.

SSOJet provides SSO integration tools supporting 25+ identity providers, allowing B2B applications to quickly implement enterprise authentication features. The platform includes a comprehensive directory showcasing how leading SaaS companies implement SSO for enterprise customers.

## Key Topics

- Enterprise SSO
- SAML 2.0
- OpenID Connect (OIDC)
- SCIM Directory Sync
- SSO Integration
- B2B SaaS Authentication
- Identity Providers (IDPs)
- SAML Integration
- OIDC Authentication
- SSO Login
- Workflow Automation
- Team Collaboration
- B2B Directory
- SaaS Authentication
- App Integration

## Product & Platform

- [SSOJet Homepage](https://ssojet.com): Enterprise SSO integration with SAML, OIDC, SCIM for 25+ IDPs
- [Enterprise SSO Directory](https://ssojet.com/b2b-sso-directory): Directory of B2B SaaS companies with enterprise SSO implementations

## Developer Reference

- [Binary to Text Encodings](https://ssojet.com/binary-encoding-decoding): Binary to text encoding reference: Ascii85, Base85, Base16, Hexadecimal
